The `setup` spec (it creates the admin and the first tenants) runs first in every group. `smoke` is what the merge queue runs; the full suite runs on main. A spec whose data another spec makes (07, 08, 10, 12 and 14-layout-apply use the tenant `Alfa Municipality` that 05 makes, 05 only works after 02, 03 and 04, and 07 to 14 use the people of 06: those five open groups b and c) lists that spec before itself in its group. Keep the groups of similar length and every spec in at least one of a, b, c, d.
